title: Slow-Cooked Beef Nihari
steps: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot. Add meat and bones, frying until browned.
Add ginger garlic paste and Nihari masala, sautéing for a few minutes until fragrant.
Pour in 6-8 cups of water, bring to a boil, cover tightly, and simmer on low heat for 3.5 to 4 hours until the meat is incredibly tender.
Dissolve the wheat flour in water to make a smooth slurry.
Slowly pour the flour slurry into the boiling gravy while stirring constantly to thicken it.
Simmer for another 15 minutes. Serve hot garnished with ginger, chilies, and a squeeze of lemon.
